projects.title: AndroGoat Security Exploitation and Analysis
projects.subtitle: An Investigation into 5 Critical Vulnerabilities in an Android Application
projects.description: A security audit of AndroGoat, an intentionally vulnerable Android app built for practising mobile penetration testing. Using dynamic analysis on a Genymotion emulator with ADB, plus static analysis with JADX, five critical weaknesses were identified, exploited and documented in a Medium write-up.
features: Insecure data storage: plaintext credentials recovered from SharedPreferences over ADB
Hardcoded secrets: a promo code and a leaked OpenAI API key found by decompiling the APK
Insecure clipboard usage exposing OTPs and card numbers to other apps
Weak root detection that relies on a single, easily bypassed function

projects.title: Android APK Malware Analysis & Reverse Engineering
projects.description: An analysis of Android APK-based malware, using reverse engineering to understand how the sample behaves. The findings are published as a write-up on LinkedIn.
features: Analysis of APK-based malware behaviour
Reverse engineering of the application package
Findings documented in a public write-up

projects.title: Python-Automated Honeypot & Intrusion Detection System (IDS)
projects.description: A Python honeypot that imitates a restricted government login gateway over a raw TCP socket. Each connection is served in its own thread, and every intruder's IP address and submitted credentials are written to a log file.
features: Convincing fake "secure gateway" terminal with boot animation and coloured ANSI boxes
Multi-threaded server that handles several intruders at once
Logs IP, username and password of every attempt with timestamps
Finishes each session with an "ACCESS DENIED" alert screen

projects.title: WebShield-Analyzer
projects.subtitle: Web Traffic & Security Log Parser
projects.description: A lightweight OSINT and web security scanner built with Python and Flask, styled with Tailwind CSS and fully dockerized. Enter a URL and it inspects security headers, reputation, exposed files and network details in one click.
features: HTTP security header checks (HSTS, CSP, X-Frame-Options) with mitigation guidance
VirusTotal lookup for malware and phishing reputation
OSINT discovery: subdomains via crt.sh, WHOIS data and Wayback Machine history
Async port scanner, IP geolocation and CMS / tech-stack detection
SPF and DMARC checks plus hunting for exposed files such as /.env and /.git/config
